aboutHero.heading: Who we are
aboutHero.body1: Bool was founded in 2013 and is part of Code For All Group. We are a boutique consulting firm that delivers custom software solutions from Portugal to the world.
aboutHero.body2: As a trusted technology partner, our experience over more than a decade in multiple sectors give us the business and technical knowledge to make a difference and generate real impact in our customers. We are a solid player in the Market and the "One Stop Shop" for their Application Development Strategy. We cover the entire application life-cycle from Ideation, to Architecture, UX/UI, Integrations, Development, Maintenance, Operation and Training.
aboutHero.mission.title: Mission
aboutHero.mission.body: Bool exists to build software that works. We want to be the reference in critical solutions, delivery, fast, reliable and driven by impact, not because we say so, but because we get it done.
aboutHero.vision.title: Vision
aboutHero.vision.body: We push business forward. Our purpose is to build real software that makes a difference. We do it by combining world-class talent across leading stacks and a relentless focus on client success. We deliver results.

servicesHero.heading: Why Bool
servicesHero.body1: At Bool, we don't just deliver software. We deliver a decisive competitive advantage. With over a decade of experience and hundreds of projects across diverse sectors, we know that the difference between a good solution and a transformative one comes down to execution.
servicesHero.body2: We are a team of AI specialists. Not consultants who advise from sidelines, but builders who work side by side with your business. We transfer knowledge and build capability within your internal teams so your organisation becomes progressively more self-sufficient. And we deliver faster and to a higher standard than any traditional development approach, meaning shorter timelines and higher return on every euro you invest.

techStack.heading: The Technologies Behind the Results
techStack.body:
Our team is fluent across the platforms that power modern business.
Whether it's rapid low-code delivery or a fully bespoke build, we bring deep expertise to every stack we touch.
techStack.platforms.1.name: OutSystems
techStack.platforms.1.body: Pioneers in OutSystems since its inception, we build applications that help businesses innovate at the speed of market demand. Our deep platform expertise allows us to deliver robust, secure, and scalable solutions, from complex integrations to high-performance enterprise apps.
techStack.platforms.2.name: Microsoft Power Platform
techStack.platforms.2.body: We harness the full potential of Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI to eliminate manual processes and unlock operational efficiency. Our solutions integrate seamlessly with your existing Microsoft ecosystem, turning data into decisions and workflows into competitive advantage.
techStack.platforms.3.name: Mendix
techStack.platforms.3.body: We develop modular, integrated solutions that bridge the gap between business and IT. With a collaborative approach at the core, our Mendix expertise enables organizations to adapt quickly to changing requirements and deliver value across complex enterprise environments.
techStack.platforms.4.name: Open Source & Custom Stack
techStack.platforms.4.body: When off-the-shelf solutions aren't enough, we design and build bespoke applications from the ground up. Leveraging modern open-source technologies, we deliver flexible, future-proof systems with the creative freedom and technical precision your project demands.

knowledgeCenter.article.1.subtitle: Enterprise Mendix · Mendix
knowledgeCenter.article.1.challenge: Fragmented processes across multiple markets led to delays, inconsistencies, and high operational cost. Manual handoffs between teams created bottlenecks impossible to resolve at scale.
knowledgeCenter.article.1.solution: A unified low-code application automating core workflows, integrating with legacy systems via a custom API layer, providing real-time visibility across all operations.
knowledgeCenter.article.2.subtitle: TechCorp Solutions · OutSystems
knowledgeCenter.article.2.challenge: Legacy monolithic architecture created deployment bottlenecks and limited the ability to scale individual services independently across regions.
knowledgeCenter.article.2.solution: Microservices-based architecture built on OutSystems, enabling independent scaling, faster deployments, and improved fault isolation across the platform.
knowledgeCenter.article.3.subtitle: Industry Benchmark · OutSystems · Mendix
knowledgeCenter.article.3.challenge: Organizations lacked objective performance data to make informed platform decisions, relying on vendor claims rather than real-world benchmarks.
knowledgeCenter.article.3.solution: Comprehensive benchmarking framework testing both platforms across identical workloads, providing actionable insights for enterprise decision-makers.
knowledgeCenter.article.4.subtitle: Enterprise Evaluation · Power Platform
knowledgeCenter.article.4.challenge: IT teams struggled to determine which low-code platform best suited their existing Microsoft ecosystem while maintaining enterprise-grade capabilities.
knowledgeCenter.article.4.solution: Detailed comparison framework evaluating integration depth, scalability limits, and total cost of ownership for Power Apps vs OutSystems deployments.
knowledgeCenter.article.5.subtitle: Legacy Modernization · How-To
knowledgeCenter.article.5.challenge: Accumulated technical debt across legacy systems was slowing feature delivery and increasing maintenance costs by 40% year over year.
knowledgeCenter.article.5.solution: Systematic debt reduction strategy combining automated code analysis, incremental refactoring, and low-code migration for the most critical components.
knowledgeCenter.article.6.subtitle: Dev Team · Open Source
knowledgeCenter.article.6.challenge: Teams needed a production-ready REST API pattern that balanced performance, maintainability, and security without vendor lock-in.
knowledgeCenter.article.6.solution: Step-by-step implementation guide covering authentication, validation, error handling, and deployment using Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
knowledgeCenter.article.7.subtitle: Security Team · OutSystems
knowledgeCenter.article.7.challenge: Rapid low-code development often bypassed security reviews, creating vulnerabilities in authentication, data access, and API exposure.
knowledgeCenter.article.7.solution: Security-first development framework for OutSystems with automated scanning, role-based access patterns, and secure API gateway configuration.
knowledgeCenter.article.8.subtitle: GlobalRetail Corp · OutSystems
knowledgeCenter.article.8.challenge: Fragmented processes across multiple markets led to delays, inconsistencies, and high operational cost. Manual handoffs between teams created bottlenecks impossible to resolve at scale.
knowledgeCenter.article.8.solution: A unified low-code application automating core workflows, integrating with legacy systems via a custom API layer, providing real-time visibility across all operations.
knowledgeCenter.article.9.subtitle: Innovation Lab · AI Integration
knowledgeCenter.article.9.challenge: Organizations wanted to leverage AI capabilities but lacked clear guidance on integrating machine learning models with existing low-code applications.
knowledgeCenter.article.9.solution: Practical integration patterns connecting AI services with low-code platforms, covering model deployment, data pipelines, and user-facing AI features.
